notes: For the March 17-18, 2026 FOMC meeting, the base-case expectation is that the Federal Reserve leaves the target range unchanged at 3.50%-3.75%. Market pricing and economist commentary point to a hold as the dominant outcome, with the committee likely to keep a cautious, data-dependent tone rather than signal an imminent easing cycle. The main watch items are whether the statement acknowledges softer labor conditions or renewed inflation pressure, which could shift the message modestly dovish or hawkish even if the rate itself is unchanged.
